comment: Every number the retro may move on its own. `loosens` says which direction makes a check more permissive (higher, lower) or never; a move that way is a large change and is only proposed. A value outside min..max is large too. The code reads these through lib/retro/tunables.mjs.

review.autoMatchMaxDiff.about: share of pixels that may differ before an item skips its reviewer

review.pixelTolerance.about: how far one colour channel may differ before a pixel counts as different

review.maxBatchItems.about: items one reviewer gets in one batch

rounds.stallRounds.about: rounds in a row whose real-bug count does not fall before the loop stops and the stuck items go to the founder

rounds.ceiling.about: the most picture rounds a run takes, whatever the counts do

review.samplePerScreen.about: items per screen sampled when earlier-matching items' pictures changed; the rest wait unless the sample finds a problem

slots.max.about: heavy jobs (shoots, e2e) at once on one machine

slots.waitTimeoutMs.about: how long a job waits for a free slot

shoot.commandTimeoutMs.about: how long one capture or shoot command may run

shoot.clickTimeoutMs.about: how long a reach step waits for a control once the page has loaded

shoot.stepPauseMs.about: pause after each reach step, before waiting for the network

shoot.settlePauseMs.about: pause after a state is reached and the network is idle, before the picture

shoot.resizePauseMs.about: pause after the window grows to the page's full height

shoot.settleQuietMs.about: how long the network stays quiet before a reach step counts as settled

shoot.settleCapMs.about: the most one reach step waits for the network to settle

shoot.parallelWorlds.about: worlds a shoot pictures at once, each in its own browser context

capture.devServerTimeoutMs.about: how long the capture waits for a dev server

capture.prodBuildTimeoutMs.about: how long the capture waits for a local production build
